headline: StockSathi's ₹499 Basic plan is the biggest threat to our Kolkata market this week.
tl_dr: StockSathi's Basic plan at ₹499/month with GST billing undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799/month plan by ₹300 [StockSathi-1-1].
StockSathi's 2G sync update, with sync payloads now 40% smaller, targets shops on weak networks [StockSathi-1-4].
BahiBook's Solo plan at ₹399/month with GST returns and ledger is a clear undercut of KiranaCloud's ₹799 plan [BahiBook-1-1].
ShelfMitra's Starter (₹1,299) and Growth (₹2,499) plans are priced above KiranaCloud and target multi-user, multi-store chains [ShelfMitra-1-1].
Hiring: StockSathi lists 3 open roles in Bengaluru [StockSathi-1-6], ShelfMitra 3 in Mumbai [ShelfMitra-1-3][ShelfMitra-1-4], and BahiBook 1 in Pune [BahiBook-1-4].
since_last_week: First brief: no earlier week to compare.

threats.rationale: StockSathi's Basic plan at ₹499/month with GST billing undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799/month Dukaan plan by ₹300 [StockSathi-1-1]. Its new 2G sync speedup [StockSathi-1-4] also supports adoption in weak-network kirana shops.

BahiBook's Solo plan at ₹399/month with GST returns and ledger is a clear undercut of KiranaCloud's ₹799 plan [BahiBook-1-1]. Its reported 50,000 users are in Maharashtra rather than Kolkata, and that report is only moderately credible [BahiBook-1-5].

ShelfMitra's Starter (₹1,299) and Growth (₹2,499) plans are priced above KiranaCloud and target multi-user, multi-store chains rather than single kirana shops [ShelfMitra-1-1]. Its purchase-order approval feature is low impact [ShelfMitra-1-2].

recommendations.action: Review KiranaCloud's ₹799 plan against StockSathi's ₹499 Basic tier and decide on a pricing response for Kolkata.
Assess sync performance on weak networks for Kolkata shops in light of StockSathi's 2G sync update.
Equip Kolkata sales to counter the single-counter shop segment where BahiBook's ₹399 Solo plan competes.

watchlist: StockSathi's 2 open Android Engineer roles and 1 Customer Success role in Bengaluru may point to app or support investment [StockSathi-1-6].
ShelfMitra's 2 Backend Engineer roles in Mumbai may signal platform work, though no product impact is confirmed [ShelfMitra-1-3].
